Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
1
Ecstatic Agony
"Each round of combat, this vampire gets +X strength, where X is the amount
of damage successfully inflicted on this vampire in the previous round of
the combat"

If I'm hit for one two rounds in a row, what's my strenght in the third
round? (asuming I have 1 strenght at start). Could IMO be interpreted (quite
close to correct spelling!?) as both 2 and three...

2
New cards. Can I use my Kiss of Ra from the FN in a tournament before July
11th, as the card existed before?

3
Shroud Mastery
"Usable by a ready vampire when a wraith ally you control is acting. The
acting wraith gets +1 stealth."
a) Can two vampires play one SM each?
b) Does the "cloaking" vampire need to be untapped?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9g3o1b$rgs$1...@taliesin.netcom.net.uk>, Henke
<d98...@stud.hh.se> writes

>1
>Ecstatic Agony
>"Each round of combat, this vampire gets +X strength, where X is the amount
>of damage successfully inflicted on this vampire in the previous round of
>the combat"
>
>If I'm hit for one two rounds in a row, what's my strenght in the third
>round? (asuming I have 1 strenght at start). Could IMO be interpreted (quite
>close to correct spelling!?) as both 2 and three...

Round 1, they have 1 strength. (default)
Round 2, they have 1 strength (default) + 1 strength (round 1) = 2
Round 3, they have 1 strength (default) + 2 strength (round 2) = 3

(Assuming your text is correct, I don't have it.)

>New cards. Can I use my Kiss of Ra from the FN in a tournament before July
>11th, as the card existed before?

You're unlikely to have a serious problem with it, from my point of
view. (Not official.)

>Shroud Mastery
>"Usable by a ready vampire when a wraith ally you control is acting. The
>acting wraith gets +1 stealth."
>a) Can two vampires play one SM each?

(Assuming it's an action modifier.)

Yes. Look at Cloak the Gathering.

The limit is one action modifier per vampire per action.

>b) Does the "cloaking" vampire need to be untapped?

Without explicit card text, all action modifiers can be played
regardless of tapped/untapped.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henke wrote:
>
> 1
> Ecstatic Agony
> "Each round of combat, this vampire gets +X strength, where X is the amount
> of damage successfully inflicted on this vampire in the previous round of
> the combat"
>
> If I'm hit for one two rounds in a row, what's my strenght in the third
> round? (asuming I have 1 strenght at start). Could IMO be interpreted (quite
> close to correct spelling!?) as both 2 and three...

Round 1: X=0 (the amount done in the non-existing previous round). 1+X = 1
Round 2: X=1. 1+X = 2
Round 3: X=1. 1+X = 2

> 2
> New cards. Can I use my Kiss of Ra from the FN in a tournament before July
> 11th, as the card existed before?

No. Final Nights cards are not legal in V:EKN-sanctioned contructed deck
tourneys
until July 11, except for Hesha and Fatima.

> 3
> Shroud Mastery
> "Usable by a ready vampire when a wraith ally you control is acting. The
> acting wraith gets +1 stealth."
> a) Can two vampires play one SM each?
> b) Does the "cloaking" vampire need to be untapped?

Yes.
No, just ready.
